entities.name: Nathan ben Jehiel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nathan ben Jehiel of Rome was a Jewish Italian lexicographer. He authored the Arukh, a dictionary for Rabbinic Judaism that was the first work to examine Jewish Babylonian Aramaic. He is therefore referred to as "the Arukh."
